highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adopts Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements.
highlights_body: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

breaking.title: Move WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets, and their build targets reject unsupported WebAssembly frameworks. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use the matching native archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ use 6.0.2. Archives are not interchangeable across these toolchains. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later, with runtime-matched archives retained for supported toolchains. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.
